# SEO Audit — neofollicletransplant.com

_Captured 2026-09-03 15:28. This archive records the site **as it is**. Nothing below was changed._

These are pre-existing conditions found during the backup. The rebuild is the natural moment to fix them —
but note the distinction: **items marked PRESERVE must be copied exactly** or rankings move; items marked FIX are safe improvements.

---

## 1. Meta descriptions — the biggest weakness

**2 pages have no meta description at all**, and **36 more have one auto-generated by Slim SEO** from page body text.
Only **21 of 59 pages** have a hand-written description.

The auto-generated ones are visibly broken — most begin with the breadcrumb `Home » <Page Name>` and cut off mid-word at ~154 characters:

```
contact-us:  "Home » Contact Us Contact Us Book Your Appointment Neo Follicle
              Transplant Clinic is a hair transplant and hair loss treatment
              clinic in Bangalore, founde"   <- truncated mid-word
```

> **Important for the migration:** these strings are generated at render time by the WordPress plugin.
> On a non-WordPress rebuild they will simply not exist. They are captured verbatim in `01-SEO-MASTER.csv`,
> but copying this particular junk forward would be a mistake — **FIX these rather than preserve them.**
> Google frequently rewrites descriptions anyway, so the ranking risk of improving them is low and the CTR upside is real.

### Pages with no description at all

- `uncategorized` — https://neofollicletransplant.com/category/uncategorized/
- `our-blogs` — https://neofollicletransplant.com/our-blogs/

## 2. Titles

- **30 of 53 indexable pages** use WordPress's default `–` separator (`Page Name – Neo Follicle Hair Transplant`) — i.e. auto-generated, not written.
- Only **11** use the hand-written `|` branded pattern (`Best Hair Transplant in Bangalore | Neo Follicle Clinic`).
- **18 titles exceed 60 characters** and will truncate in search results.
- No duplicate titles and no duplicate descriptions anywhere — that part is clean.

## 3. Broken assets referenced in live markup — FIX

**6 image URLs referenced by the site return HTTP 404.** Verified with a browser User-Agent and a same-site Referer, so this is not hotlink protection.

The two most damaging are referenced from **structured data**, meaning Google cannot fetch the doctor's image for the `Physician` entity:

| Missing file | Referenced from | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| `2025/05/Dr-Sandeep-Mahapatra.jpg` | JSON-LD `Physician` image on 4+ pages | E-E-A-T entity image broken |
| `2025/05/Dr-Sandeep-Mahapatra-Hair-Transplant-Surgeon.jpeg` | JSON-LD on the surgeon's own page | E-E-A-T entity image broken |
| `2025/03/noun-experience-7640630-FFF2F2.svg` | `<img>` + `preload` on many pages | visibly broken icon site-wide |
| `2026/06/the-norwood-scale-stages-of-hair-loss.png` | JSON-LD on `male-pattern-hair-loss` | broken diagram reference |
| `2025/03/Hair-loss-treatment-before-after.jpeg` | JSON-LD on `alopecia-areata-treatment-in-bangalore` | broken |
| `2025/03/GFC-Hair-Treatment-Successful-Result-in-Bangalore-300x208.jpg` | JSON-LD on `dandruff-treatment-in-bangalore` | broken |

## 4. Structured data

- All **59 pages** carry valid, parseable JSON-LD. Coverage is genuinely strong (14 FAQPages, MedicalClinic, Physician, Service, BreadcrumbList).
- **29 pages reuse the same `@id` for two different nodes** (e.g. `#webpage` declared once as `WebPage` and again as `MedicalWebPage`).
  In JSON-LD an `@id` is a unique entity identifier; duplicating it makes the graph ambiguous and Google may merge or discard one node.
  **FIX in the rebuild** — give each node a distinct `@id`, or merge them into one node with an array `@type`.

---
## 5. Images

- **1304 `<img>` tags** across the site; **121 have an empty or missing `alt`**.
- **16 media-library items** have junk alt text — filenames or bare numbers like `"3 (1)"`, `"2 (1)"`.
- **FIX**: descriptive alt text is a cheap win for image search, and this clinic's before/after gallery is exactly the kind of content that earns image traffic.

---
## 6. Indexation — PRESERVE EXACTLY

- **6 live pages carry `noindex, follow`** and are excluded from the sitemap. They are ad landing pages.
  **The rebuild must keep them `noindex`.** Publishing them would create thin, near-duplicate pages competing with the main service pages.
- All 53 indexable pages have a **self-referencing canonical with a trailing slash**. The trailing-slash convention must be preserved,
  or every URL becomes a redirect and link equity is diluted.
- `robots.txt` disallows `/wp-admin/`, `/?s=`, `/search/`. On a non-WordPress rebuild these become irrelevant, but the `Sitemap:` directive must be carried over.
- **No `llms.txt` exists** (confirmed 404). Optional to add; it is not a ranking factor today.

---
## 7. Internal linking — orphaned pages

Built from every `<a href>` across all 59 pages, deduplicated to unique page-to-page edges.

Most pages sit at ~54 inbound links because the header mega-menu and footer link almost everything sitewide.
A few get nothing at all:

| Orphan page | Inbound | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `contact-us` | **0** | In the sitemap, and declared as `ContactPage` in JSON-LD — but **no other page links to it**. The nav and CTAs use on-page `#contact` anchors (12 pages) instead. |
| `hair-conditions-we-treat` | **0** | A real content page with no route in from anywhere. |
| `ai-hair-transplant-cost-calculator` | 0 | Ad landing page — expected, `noindex`. |
| `nft-brochure-thank-you`, `thank-you-lp`, `*-lp` | 0 | Post-conversion / ad pages — expected. |
| `sample-page`, `uncategorized` | 0 | WordPress defaults — should not be migrated. |

> **FIX — the highest-value quick win in this audit.** `contact-us` is the conversion page of a
> lead-generation medical site. It is indexable, it is in the sitemap, Google is explicitly told it is the
> `ContactPage` — and it receives no internal link equity whatsoever. Linking it from the header and footer
> is a trivial change with real upside.

Blog posts are also thinly linked (most have 1-2 inbound). Contextual links from the service pages into
the related posts would push equity into that content.

---
## 8. Heading structure

- **3 pages have no `<h1>`**: `hair-assessment`, `nft-brochure-thank-you`, `thank-you-lp` — all are thank-you / assessment pages, low impact.
- **`sample-page` has 23 `<h1>` tags** — it is the default WordPress sample page and should simply be deleted, not migrated.
- `maintenance-page`, `sample-page` and `uncategorized` are all **indexable but worthless**. Recommend `noindex` or deletion rather than porting them.

---
## Priority summary

| Priority | Action | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **P0 — preserve** | Keep all 53 slugs, trailing slashes, and self-canonicals identical | Any change forces redirects and risks ranking loss |
| **P0 — preserve** | Port all 59 JSON-LD graphs, especially the 14 FAQPages | Rich results are earned; losing them loses SERP real estate |
| **P0 — preserve** | Keep `noindex` on the 6 ad landing pages | Prevents thin duplicates cannibalising money pages |
| **P1 — fix** | Write real meta descriptions for the 40 auto-generated/missing pages | Currently breadcrumb junk truncated mid-word; direct CTR gain |
| **P1 — fix** | Restore or re-point the 6 broken image URLs | Two break the `Physician` entity image in structured data |
| **P1 — fix** | Link `contact-us` from the header and footer | The conversion page currently has zero internal inbound links |
| **P2 — fix** | Rewrite the 18 over-length titles; move the 30 `–` titles to the branded `\|` pattern | Prevents SERP truncation |
| **P2 — fix** | Give each JSON-LD node a unique `@id` on the 29 affected pages | Removes graph ambiguity |
| **P3 — fix** | Add descriptive alt text | Image-search opportunity for before/after gallery |
| **P3 — drop** | Do not migrate `sample-page`, `maintenance-page`, `uncategorized` | Thin/default pages currently indexable |
